'''2001 South Carolina State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in South Carolina in 2001. [[Brad Reinhold]] won it.<ref name="dt-16256">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16256 SC States Champion light 2001], DeckTech (Brad "Admiral Twk" Reinhold, 28 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16256/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16256/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 12 May 2001<ref name="tr-d2370" />
* '''Site:''' South Carolina; Haven Games, Greenville, SC<ref name="tr-d2370" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Reinhold]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Reinhold posted his Light deck as "SC States Champion light 2001"; it was undefeated until States and 22–1 overall, ten of those games in tournaments. He wrote that the list is not card for card what he played, because of last-minute changes he could not recall.<ref name="dt-16256" />

His Dark deck went 4–0 at States; the differentials were low, the highest +5. The version he ran there had The Circle Is Now Complete, a fourth Put All Sections On Alert and Weapon Levitation in place of the three Senses in the posted list.<ref name="dt-16165" />
